name: Cannalicious | 7g Wax Bucket | Cream Caramel
description:
Caramel Cream is a euphoric and herbal indica-dominant strain renowned for its rich flavor profile and potent effects. Bred by Humboldt Seed Company, it is a cross between Royal Highness, Old School Cookies, and Humboldt Reserve OG. Users report feelings of relaxation, happiness, and sleepiness. It is commonly used to alleviate symptoms of pain, stress, and depression. 

Wax is a terpene and cannabinoid-rich concentrate with a cream-like texture that provides a rich and flavorful experience. It has an easy-to-work-with consistency and an immediate activation time.

Activation time: Immediate
1/4 Ounce
